arxiv-2011-06799.title: Particle acceleration driven by null electromagnetic fields near a Kerr black hole
arxiv-2011-06799.creator: Yasufumi Kojima, Yuto Kimura
arxiv-2011-06799.description: Abstract Short timescale variability is often associated with a black hole system. The consequence of an electromagnetic outflow suddenly generated near a Kerr black hole is considered assuming that it is described by a solution of a force-free field with a null electric current. We compute charged particle acceleration induced by the burst field.

arxiv-2111-10278.title: Mean-field and kinetic limit of affine control systems: optimal control through leaders
arxiv-2111-10278.creator: Marta Zoppello
arxiv-2111-10278.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Marta Zoppello. This paper studies a multi-agent system starting from a single agent dynamics which is a nonlinear affine control system. It analyze what happens when the number of agents goes to infinity using two different approaches, a granular mean-field one, trying to control only a finite number of agents while all the others goes to infinity, and a kinetic one, when in the limit the percentage of controlled agents is preserved.

arxiv-2307-08131.description: Abstract Leveraging network information for predictive modeling has become widespread in many domains. Within the realm of referral and targeted marketing, influencer detection stands out as an area that could greatly benefit from the incorporation of dynamic network representation due to the continuous evolution of customer-brand relationships.

arxiv-2309-07231.title: A new covariant formalism for kinetic plasma simulations in curved spacetimes
arxiv-2309-07231.creator: Tyler Trent, Pierre Christian, Chi-kwan Chan, Dimitrios Psaltis, Feryal Özel
arxiv-2309-07231.description: Abstract Low density plasmas are characterized by a large scale separation between the gyromotion of particles around local magnetic fields and the macroscopic scales of the system, often making global kinetic simulations computationally intractable. The guiding center formalism has been proposed as a powerful tool to bridge the gap between these scales.

arxiv-2310-17056.title: Strategizing EV Charging and Renewable Integration in Texas
arxiv-2310-17056.creator: Mohammad Mohammadi, Jesse Thornburg
arxiv-2310-17056.description: Abstract Exploring the convergence of electric vehicles (EVs), renewable energy, and smart grid technologies in the context of Texas, this study addresses challenges hindering the widespread adoption of EVs. Acknowledging their environmental benefits, the research focuses on grid stability concerns, uncoordinated charging patterns, and the complicated relationship between EVs and renewable energy sources.

arxiv-2311-05740.title: Generating Pragmatic Examples to Train Neural Program Synthesizers
arxiv-2311-05740.creator: Saujas Vaduguru, Daniel Fried, Yewen Pu
arxiv-2311-05740.description: Abstract Programming-by-example is the task of synthesizing a program that is consistent with a set of user-provided input-output examples. As examples are often an under-specification of one’s intent, a good synthesizer must choose the intended program from the many that are consistent with the given set of examples.

arxiv-2403-09856.description: Abstract . Stack Overflow is widely recognized by software practitioners as the go-to resource for addressing technical issues and sharing practical solutions. While not typically seen as a scholarly forum, users on Stack Overflow commonly refer to academic sources in their discussions.

arxiv-2404-03848.title: On sncc -inheritance of pointwise almost periodicity in flows Thanks: The author was supported in part by NSFC Grant #12271245.
arxiv-2404-03848.creator: Xiongping Dai
arxiv-2404-03848.description: Abstract . Let H H be a subnormal co-compact closed subgroup of a Hausdorff topological group T T and X X a compact Hausdorff space. We prove the inheritance theorem: A point of X X is almost periodic (a.p.) for T ↷ X T\curvearrowright X iff it is a.p. for H ↷ X H\curvearrowright X .

arxiv-2501-13254.title: Flying shape and aerodynamics of a full-scale flexible Olympic windsurf sail Journal: Ocean Engineering
arxiv-2501-13254.creator: Jishen Zhang, Gauthier Bertrand, Marc Rabaud, Benoît Augier, Marc Fermigier
arxiv-2501-13254.description: Abstract The 3D flying shape of a real-scale 8 m 2 \mathrm{m^{2}} iQFOiL class windsurf sail is measured in steady state sailing configurations. The sea wind flow conditions are simulated in a large-scale wind tunnel and stereo camera imaging technique ensure the flying shape reconstruction.

arxiv-2501-14668.title: Symplectic log Kodaira dimension − ∞ -\infty , affine-ruledness and unicuspidal rational curves
arxiv-2501-14668.creator: Tian-Jun Li and Shengzhen Ning
arxiv-2501-14668.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tian-Jun Li and Shengzhen Ning. Given a closed symplectic 4 4 -manifold ( X , ω ) (X,\omega) , a collection D D of embedded symplectic submanifolds satisfying certain normal crossing conditions is called a symplectic divisor. In this paper, we consider the pair ( X , ω , D ) (X,\omega,D) with symplectic log Kodaira dimension − ∞ -\infty in the spirit of Li-Zhang.

arxiv-2503-01956.title: Lost in the FoG: Pitfalls of Models for Large-Scale Hydrogen Distributions
arxiv-2503-01956.creator: Calvin K. Osinga, Benedikt Diemer, Francisco Villaescusa-Navarro
arxiv-2503-01956.description: Abstract Large-scale H {\rm H} i surveys and their cross-correlations with galaxy distributions have immense potential as cosmological probes. Interpreting these measurements requires theoretical models that must incorporate redshift-space distortions (RSDs), such as the Kaiser and fingers-of-God (FoG) effect, and differences in the tracer and matter distributions via the tracer bias.

arxiv-2508-11136.title: Automating the Derivation of Unification Algorithms
arxiv-2508-11136.creator: Richard Waldinger
arxiv-2508-11136.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Richard Waldinger. The unification algorithm has long been a target for program synthesis research, but a fully automatic derivation remains a research goal. In deductive program synthesis, computer programming is phrased as a task in theorem proving; a declarative specification is expressed in logical form and presented to an automatic theorem prover, and a program meeting the specification is extracted from the proof. The correctness of the program is supported by the proof, which also provides an explanation of how the program works.

arxiv-2509-03743.title: Link Statistics of Dislocation Network during Strain Hardening
arxiv-2509-03743.creator: Sh. Akhondzadeh, Hanfeng Zhai, Wurong Jian, Ryan B. Sills, Nicolas Bertin, Wei Cai
arxiv-2509-03743.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sh. Akhondzadeh, Hanfeng Zhai, Wurong Jian, Ryan B. Sills, Nicolas Bertin, Wei Cai. Dislocations are line defects in crystals that multiply and self-organize into a complex network during strain hardening. The length of dislocation links, connecting neighboring nodes within this network, contains crucial information about the evolving dislocation microstructure. By analyzing data from Discrete Dislocation Dynamics (DDD) simulations in face-centered cubic (fcc) Cu, we characterize the statistical distribution of link lengths of dislocation networks during strain hardening on individual slip systems.

arxiv-2510-27563.title: Synthesis of organic-inorganic perovskite and all-inorganic lead-free double perovskite nanocrystals by femtosecond laser pulses
arxiv-2510-27563.creator: Volodymyr Vasylkovskyi, Andrey B. Evlyukhin, Elena Schlein, Mykola Slipchenko, Roman Kiyan, Kestutis Kurselis, Vladimir Dyakonov, Boris Chichkov
arxiv-2510-27563.description: Abstract Perovskite materials are at the forefront of modern materials science due to their exceptional structural, electronic, and optical properties. The controlled fabrication of perovskite nanostructures is crucial for enhancing their performance, stability, and scalability, directly impacting their applications in next-generation devices such as solar cells, LEDs, and sensors.

arxiv-2511-05351.title: When is a sloshing vortex an analogue black hole bomb?
arxiv-2511-05351.creator: Sam Patrick \aff 1, Leonardo Solidoro \aff 2,3, Maurício Richartz \aff 4, Pietro Smaniotto \aff 2,3, Patrik Švančara \aff 2,3 \corresp Present address: Institut Néel, CNRS, 25 avenue des Martyrs, 38042 Grenoble, France, Silke Weinfurtner \aff 2,3,5, Ruth Gregory \aff 1,6
arxiv-2511-05351.description: Abstract Draining vortices provide a powerful platform for simulating black hole phenomena in tabletop experiments. In realistic fluid systems confined within a finite container, low-frequency waves amplified by the vortex are reflected at the walls, rendering the system unstable. This process, known in the gravitational context as the black hole bomb, manifests as a sloshing motion of the free surface.

pmc-10648375.title: The Epigenetic Controller Lysine-Specific Demethylase 1 (LSD1) Regulates the Outcome of Hepatitis C Viral Infection
pmc-10648375.creator: Georgia Papadopoulou, Stavroula Petroulia, Eirini Karamichali, Alexios Dimitriadis, Dimitrios Marousis, Elisavet Ioannidou, Panagiota Papazafiri, John Koskinas, Pelagia Foka, Urania Georgopoulou, Alexander E Kalyuzhny
pmc-10648375.description: Hepatitis C virus (HCV) alters gene expression epigenetically to rearrange the cellular microenvironment in a beneficial way for its life cycle. The host epigenetic changes induced by HCV lead to metabolic dysfunction and malignant transformation. Lysine-specific demethylase 1 (LSD1) is an epigenetic controller of critical cellular functions that are essential for HCV propagation.

pmc-10837577.title: Effect of Adverse Childhood Experiences, Parenting Styles, and Family Accommodation on Patients Diagnosed with Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
pmc-10837577.creator: Ziming Xu, Cheng Zhu
pmc-10837577.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background:Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) is a mental illness that has multiple biological, psychological, and sociological factors. The aim of this study was to investigate childhood traumatic experiences, parenting style, and family adaptive behaviors in patients with OCD, to explore the psychosocial factors that affect its occurrence, and to analyze the correlation between these psychosocial factors and OCD symptoms to better understand its etiology.Methods:We recruited 109 patients diagnosed with OCD (patient group) and 144 healthy controls (control group) into this study.

pmc-11395713.description: Electrochemical migration (ECM) on the surface of printed circuit boards (PCBs) continues to pose a significant reliability risk in electronics. pmc-12552854.creator: Mustafa Oguz Cumaoglu, Durmus Ayan, Abdussamed Vural, Turgut Dolanbay, Caner Ozbey, Abdul Ridvan Kulu

pmc-12812927.title: Sufficient stability using retrograde cannulated screws in a metacarpal fracture model: a biomechanical evaluation
pmc-12812927.creator: Maximilian Heilig, Julian Wagenhäuser, Henner Huflage, Philipp Heilig, Martin Cornelius Jordan, Rafael Gregor Jakubietz, Rainer Heribert Meffert, Stefanie Hoelscher-Doht
pmc-12812927.description: IntroductionThe treatment of metacarpal shaft fractures using cannulated compression screws has become a viable method of osteosynthesis in recent years. However, most biomechanical studies focus primarily on the ultimate failure load, comparing it to plating or K-wires. There is limited biomechanical data how cannulated compression screws perform under realistic cyclic loads encountered during postoperative physiotherapy in comparison to plating.

pmc-13414357.creator: Mohit Kakar, Georgijs Kulibaba, Zahraa Merchant, Astra Zviedre, Timurs Zurmutai, Lasma Asare, Peteris Tretjakovs, Arnis Engelis, Aigars Petersons
pmc-13414357.description: Background and Objectives: Acute appendicitis is the most common surgical emergency in children. The standard of care has been appendectomy for many years. However, in recent years, studies investigating antibiotic therapy alone have increased rapidly, suggesting that non-operative management may be an effective alternative with a lower risk of complications.

pmc-13469018.title: Effects of Antecedent and Consequence Secondary Targets on Intraverbal Teaching
pmc-13469018.creator: Julian Cifuentes, Manish Goyal, Lesley A Shawler
pmc-13469018.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Children diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) may have difficulty with social interactions and communication. Thus, identifying procedures that are efficient and effective at improving communication is important. Instructive feedback (IF) is a procedure that has been found to increase communication for individuals with developmental disabilities by teaching a primary target (PT) and embedding a secondary target (ST) within the learning trial. However, different procedural configurations exist across the IF literature, which may influence its efficacy and efficiency.

pmc-13525941.title: Suspected shrinking lung syndrome: a rare pulmonary manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus—a case-based review of an underrecognized condition
pmc-13525941.creator: Maciej Maj, Maria Oknińska, Joanna Robaczyńska, Martyna Dziewit, Marzena Olesińska, Maria Maślińska
pmc-13525941.description: Shrinking lung syndrome (SLS) is a rare pulmonary manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). It is characterized by unexplained dyspnea, restrictive ventilatory defect, and diaphragmatic elevation without interstitial lung disease (ILD). A 32-year-old man with SLE presented with progressive dyspnea initially attributed to pleural and infectious processes. As systemic features evolved, SLE was confirmed.

uslaw-cfr-t42-s137-145.title: 42 C.F.R. § 137.145 — If the Secretary rejects a final offer, is the Secretary required to provide the Indian Tribe with technical assistance?
uslaw-cfr-t42-s137-145.creator: Public Health Service, Department Of Health And Human Services
uslaw-cfr-t42-s137-145.description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 42 (Public Health), Part 137 (Tribal Self-Governance). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). Yes, the Secretary must offer and, if requested by the Indian Tribe, provide additional technical assistance to overcome the stated grounds for rejection.
